en: Black‑and‑white view of a landscaped park with curved paths and benches in the foreground, dominated on the right by a large monument: a standing military figure on a high pedestal, with allegorical statues, rocks and a lion at the base. Behind the park rise ornate spa-style buildings on a hillside, surrounded by forested slopes. On one hillside building a large sign advertises a hotel. The overall scene evokes a Central European spa town from the late 19th or early 20th century.
